_comment: Manual corrections to the red-underline derivation, applied after the
structural rule in import.js. List cards by name or by card number.
Rulebook 7.3: an underlined title means the Event's effects last for the
duration of the game. Rulebook 2.2.5: such cards stay face-up beside the
board until cancelled or the game ends. So the test is permanence, not
merely 'has a lasting effect' -- end-of-turn events do not qualify.
Derived as: PutThisCardInPlay with argument 0 (0 = indefinite, 1 = for the
turn), plus PutThisCardInPlaySpecial (Shuttle Diplomacy, in play until
cancelled), plus Quagmire and Bear Trap by hand. Yields 20 cards.
Verified by measuring the red rule directly on 12 Twilight Strategy scans:
underlined     - NATO, NORAD, Quagmire, Flower Power
not underlined - Containment, Brezhnev Doctrine, Red Scare/Purge,
Latin American Death Squads, We Will Bury You,
Missile Envy, Socialist Governments, Indo-Pakistani War
The remaining cards are derived, not confirmed. Render the deck, compare
against the wiki, and add corrections below.
